name: uppercase_filename_and_lookup

name: close_intuition_screen_by_name
description: Finds the named screen's message port, removes that port and closes the Intuition screen. When no such port exists it reports that the screen cannot be found, and it prints a usage line for missing arguments.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picshow:0:0000
name: entry_open_required_libraries
description: Program entry point that opens the exec library by name and then, through the exec base, obtains further library and screen pointers. It stores those pointers and calls the setup routines in turn, stopping if a library fails to open.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picshow:0:0004
name: write_string_if_nonempty
description: Measures the null-terminated string in the buffer and, when it is longer than one character and the length flag is set, writes it through dos.Write. It returns the write result, or zero when nothing is written.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picshow:0:0028
name: lock_examine_and_read_file
description: Locks and examines a named file, opens and reads it through dos when the examined entry qualifies, then closes it and releases the lock. Each dos step is checked before the next one runs; it calls five other routines.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picshow:0:0108
name: allocate_memory_with_size_header
description: Allocates a memory block through exec.AllocMem and, on success, stores the requested size plus four bytes as a header in the block's first longword. It returns the size and flag registers unchanged.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picshow:0:012A
name: free_memory_block_if_set
description: Frees a memory block through exec.FreeMem when the pointer is non-null and leaves the registers unchanged otherwise.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picshow:0:0156
name: terminate_string_at_length
description: Records the buffer address in shared state and, when a flag there is set, writes a null terminator at the end of the buffer for the given length. It does nothing when the flag is clear.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:c/picshow:0:016E
name: split_next_argument_token
description: Scans the saved command line from its current position, skipping spaces, and returns the next argument. A quoted run counts as one argument, and unquoted arguments end at a space or comma; each one is null-terminated in place and the position is saved for the next call.

description: Parses an IFF picture's header, palette and body chunks, applies the palette colours, and unpacks the run-length compressed body into the bitplanes of a new bitmap. It also builds the screen structure around that bitmap and returns a status word.

name: load_picture_into_screen
description: Command routine that opens an IFF picture as a new Intuition screen: it allocates a signal, adds a message port, sets the palette colours and opens the screen, closing it again on failure. It reports insufficient memory and prints a usage line for the file argument.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:s/INTRO:0:0000
name: decode_packed_intro_and_start
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, then unpacks a run-length packed block backward into memory, with negative counts repeating a byte and positive counts copying literal bytes. It reads the DMA status register, writes the interrupt control registers, and then calls a series of routines.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:cls:0:0000
name: write_output_via_dos_library
description: Opens the dos library, takes its output handle, and writes through it; when the write reports an error it calls a further dos function and returns that result, otherwise it returns zero.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:0000
name: call_routine_from_entry
description: Three-instruction program entry that calls one other routine. No pseudo-code was available, so the description rests on that call and the entry point alone.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:000A
name: init_dma_colour_sprite_regs
description: Writes the background colour, the sprite-zero pointer and the DMA and interrupt enable registers, then calls the start routine. The relocation entry calls it, and no pseudo-code was available.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:005C
name: relocate_depacker_and_start
description: Copies the depacker routine to low memory and a second code block into place, clears a run of sprite-pointer words, sets the blitter masks and bitplane modulo registers, then calls the relocated depacker.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:00FC
name: unpack_ice_data_block
description: Checks the first longword for the ICE packer signature and, if it matches, runs the ICE decoding routines and copies the unpacked bytes to their destination. Otherwise it returns without changes.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:015E
name: return_stack_top_value
description: Returns the value found at the top of the stack without other work. It is the tail target of the depacker.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:0164
name: run_ice_decode_loop
description: Main ICE decoding loop: while output remains, it copies a literal byte run or, when the flag bit says so, decodes a length and distance pair and copies that many earlier bytes backward into the output.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:0190
name: short_delay_countdown
description: Counts a short register down from three to zero as a timing delay, then returns. Only the depacker calls it.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:019C
name: shift_in_ice_stream_bits
description: Shifts bits from the compressed stream into the carry bit for a set count, refilling from the next stream word when the buffer runs out.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:01AA
name: refill_ice_bit_buffer
description: Refills the bit buffer from the compressed stream one word at a time, shifting out bits until the requested count is reached. It hands over to the single-bit reader when the buffer runs out.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:01BC
name: test_ice_bit_buffer
description: Tests whether the bit buffer still holds bits and whether the stream pointer is aligned, then returns. It is the availability check the decoder runs before reading bits, and it forwards to a second test routine.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:01C2
name: test_ice_stream_alignment
description: Tests the low bit of the stream pointer and returns without changing state. It forwards to an empty return routine.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:01D0
name: return_without_action
description: Empty routine that only returns. It is the final target of the bit-test chain.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:01E2
name: shift_next_ice_stream_bit
description: Shifts the next bit out of the bit buffer for a loop count, loading a new stream word when the buffer is empty. It is the single-bit reader used by the decoder.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:01F0
name: decode_ice_length_and_distance
description: Decodes the next compressed token by reading flag and bit-count codes from the bit stream, then either sets a copy length from a lookup table or hands over to the byte-copy routine. It calls three decoder routines.

key: ghouls 'n ghosts (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr family]/Ghouls 'N Ghosts (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr Family].adf:1:0:0230
name: copy_ice_distance_bytes
description: Copies a run of previously decoded bytes backward to the output, using a distance read from the bit stream, and loops until the count is used up. It then tail-calls the main decode loop.

name: initialise_runtime_state_and_pause
description: Runs a sequence of setup calls that store addresses into the runtime segment, touches the CIA A port register that carries the fire-button and disk status bits, then spins in a countdown delay before returning.

name: fill_table_with_stride_addresses
description: Fills a table of longwords with addresses starting from a fixed base and stepping by a fixed size per entry, with the entry count taken from a stored value. It calls one other routine.

name: build_sign_bit_lookup_table
description: Fills a 256-byte lookup table where each entry is built from the index bits, with the top bit set by threshold tests on the index and a parity bit that alternates from entry to entry. It calls one other routine.

name: offset_coordinate_list_into_records
description: Walks a coordinate list ending with the value minus-one, adds a base x and y to each pair, and stores the results at the start of each record. Records are spaced by a fixed stride.

name: offset_coordinate_list_second_pair
description: Walks the same coordinate list as its neighbour, adding base x and y to each pair and storing the results at a later offset inside each record. It also builds a fixed control word.

name: dispatch_record_handlers_table
description: Iterates over fixed-size records and calls the handler whose table index is stored in each record when that index is nonzero. It also writes the copper, DMA and interrupt control registers around the dispatch.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Writes a mask that clears all DMA channel bits and stores a few addresses, then runs into undecodable bytes, so the rest of the decompiled body is unreliable.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stores a few address words and then runs into undecodable bytes, so only the first stores are meaningful. It is a stub of bad instruction data.

name: set_shared_byte_to_ones
description: Writes an all-ones value to one shared byte and returns. Nothing else is touched.

name: handle_interrupt_request_flags
description: Checks two flag bits in a shared byte: when the first is set it records that and returns; when the second is set it records it and calls a series of routines. The body then runs into undecodable bytes, so its tail is unreliable.

name: clear_interrupt_request_flag
description: Clears the top bit of a shared interrupt value, leaves the other bits unchanged, and returns its input value unchanged. Only one other routine calls it.

name: enable_interrupts_and_dma_masks
description: Writes several interrupt-enable and DMA-enable masks to the custom chip registers and sets a CIA A interrupt control value, then returns.

name: tick_shared_counter
description: Calls a series of routines, most of them empty, then increments a shared counter before returning. It calls three other routines and an empty stub.

name: reset_input_state_and_setup
description: When a shared flag bit is clear, toggles a status bit, zeroes the shared byte, stores addresses into the runtime segment and calls setup routines. It touches the CIA A port that holds the fire-button and disk status bits.

name: poll_joystick_port_flags
description: Calls two routines, then sets a shared status bit when the flag at a fixed bit is clear. It reads the CIA A port with the fire-button and disk status bits and the mouse and joystick port data registers.

name: decode_joystick_direction_bits
description: Converts a joystick-port register value into a four-bit direction mask, deriving each bit from XOR tests on adjacent bit pairs. The mask is stored in the byte given by the caller.

name: decode_keyboard_key_code
description: Stores a key-code byte from keyboard input, inverts and rotates it into the key code, then waits on the serial interrupt flag before resetting the CIA A interrupt control value. It calls one other routine.

name: handshake_keyboard_serial_line
description: Stores the keyboard serial data, inverts and rotates it into a key code, then waits on the serial timer interrupt flag before clearing the serial control registers. It is the keyboard serial acknowledge step.

name: decrement_shared_counter_if_set
description: Decrements a shared byte counter when it is nonzero and returns; otherwise it returns without change.

name: copy_words_into_strided_table
description: Copies thirty-two words from a source array into a destination at a stride of four bytes, storing each one in the second word of its slot. It is a plain array copy with no checks.

name: init_and_wait_for_blitter
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, writes the interrupt enable mask that clears all channels, calls a fixed routine and then a run of other routines. It reads the DMA status and interrupt registers.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Checks a few pointers and writes some words into the runtime segment, then runs into undecodable bytes, so the rest of the body is unreliable.

name: reset_interrupts_and_run_setup
description: Clears the interrupt enables, waits for the blitter to go idle, then runs seven setup routines, including the copper-list start, and returns its first argument unchanged.

name: forward_to_fixed_routine
description: Calls one fixed routine and returns. It does nothing else.

name: forward_to_one_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with nothing else done. Its address is taken by a move, so it is a jump-table entry.

name: clear_interrupts_start_copper_list
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, clears the interrupt enables, stores its input word in shared state, then calls the copper-list start routine and four other routines.

name: scan_record_table_for_letter
description: Walks a table of records fifty bytes apart; for records of type six it scans a text buffer for the letter o and advances past it. It stops at a negative record marker and calls three routines.

name: scan_record_table_for_letter
description: Walks the same record table as its neighbour, scanning text for the letter o on type-six records until it reaches a terminator record. It then falls through to two other routines.

name: scan_record_table_for_letter
description: Walks the same record table as its neighbours and scans the text buffer for the letter o on type-six records, stopping at a terminator record. It calls three other routines.

name: dispatch_record_table_entries
description: Walks a table of fifty-byte records, storing each non-negative code in shared state and calling a handler from a dispatch table, stopping at the first negative record. It calls one other routine.

name: run_record_script_dispatch
description: Runs through a record table, calling a handler for each entry from a dispatch table until a terminator stops it. It then waits while a shared flag bit is set and returns; a second record code leads into undecodable bytes.

name: check_fire_button_flag
description: Checks a shared flag bit that reflects the fire-button and disk status and, when the bit is clear, spins while it is set. It is called by two routines.

name: initialise_sprite_record_table
description: Writes a fixed value into one field of a hundred and fifty-seven twenty-four-byte records and clears or sets several other fields in each one.

name: run_blitter_operation
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its control, modulo, destination pointer and size registers, then waits for it to finish.

name: update_display_records_at_raster
description: Sets a status bit from a record field, then loops over a table of records writing values into them. It waits for a given raster line and makes a series of update calls, relying on the beam-position wait routine.

name: return_empty_stub
description: Empty routine that returns at once. Two other routines call it.

name: copy_table_words_into_records
description: Copies a column of words from a source table, chosen by the caller's index and a fixed row size, into one field of consecutive twenty-four-byte records.

name: copy_table_words_to_slot
description: Copies a column of words from a source table, chosen by the caller's index and a fixed row size, into a second field of consecutive twenty-four-byte records.

name: set_bitplane_pointers_and_modulo
description: Writes two bitplane address pointers stepping by forty bytes per row into a list, sets a fixed width value in each of a hundred and fifty-seven records, and stores three addresses for the display.

name: compute_aligned_rectangle_masks
description: Aligns a rectangle's coordinates to word boundaries by setting their low bits, then calls nine routines that act on the aligned region.

name: set_display_dimensions_then_draw
description: Stores a row stride of forty, a width of three hundred and twenty, a height of a hundred and fifty-eight and a source address into shared state, then calls three routines.

name: set_region_dimensions_then_copy
description: Stores a region height, width, source and destination addresses into shared state, then calls three routines.

name: select_table_entry_and_draw
description: Indexes a table of eight-byte entries by the caller's index, loads the entry's word fields into shared state, and calls seven routines.

name: advance_shared_position_then_draw
description: Advances a shared position by two hundred and forty-five, clears a counter, sets a fixed value and calls two routines.

name: advance_shared_position_then_draw
description: Advances a shared position by two hundred and forty-five, clears a counter, sets a fixed value and calls two routines.

name: advance_row_offset_then_draw
description: Adds forty to a shared row offset, sets two fixed values and calls two routines.

name: advance_column_offset_then_draw
description: Advances a shared offset by one hundred and fifty-eight, sets a value of one hundred and fifty-nine and calls two routines.

name: advance_offset_and_select_entry
description: Advances a shared offset by seventy-eight, looks up an eight-byte table entry by the caller's index and calls six routines to act on it.

name: install_handler_and_run_steps
description: Stores the address of a handler routine in shared state, calls another routine, sets three shared values and calls two more routines.

name: load_record_fields_into_state
description: Copies two fields from a record into shared state, computes an address from a third field, and calls two routines.

name: compute_record_addresses_and_fill
description: Computes two addresses from record fields and a fixed table base, stores them in shared state, sets a bit in a memory cell and calls two routines.

name: configure_record_table_and_draw
description: Sets several shared addresses and fields, then fills a record table through nine routines, writing single-bit flags into memory cells as it goes.

name: check_table_entry_then_update
description: Looks up a longword through a table pointer and, when it is nonzero, calls two routines to update the record.

name: run_threshold_scan_loop
description: Repeatedly calls three routines per pass, comparing a returned value against a shared limit to choose between two follow-up routines, and loops until a returned word reaches zero. It calls two routines before the loop starts.

name: run_threshold_scan_loop

name: scan_until_limit_then_set
description: Loops through a sequence of routine calls and compares a returned value against a shared limit. When the value is zero it sets two shared values and returns; otherwise it advances and repeats.

name: return_empty_stub
description: Empty routine that returns at once. Three other routines call it.

name: copy_words_into_records
description: Copies words from a source buffer into one field of consecutive records, wrapping back to the start of the buffer and stopping at a fixed end address.

name: advance_word_pointer_by_two
description: Advances a shared word pointer by two bytes and returns; the comparison that follows has no effect.

name: copy_words_into_mirrored_records
description: Copies words from a source buffer into one field of records stepping forward and into another field stepping backward, wrapping the source at its end.

name: copy_words_then_mask_records
description: Copies a hundred and fifty-six words into one field of consecutive records, then computes a masked value from shared state and writes it into a second field of the records.

name: step_pointers_by_table_offsets
description: Advances two shared pointers by the offsets stored at them, unless they have reached their end values, then calls two routines and returns their result.

name: advance_pointer_by_table_offsets
description: Advances a shared pointer by two offsets read from the pointer's own table, calling two routines around the update.

name: write_record_pair_and_advance
description: If the shared pointer has not reached the end, writes the same value into two fields of the record it points to and moves on to the next record.

name: write_record_pair_and_retreat
description: If the shared pointer has not reached the start, writes a negative value into two fields of the record it points to and moves back one record.

name: increment_counter_until_limit
description: Increments a shared counter and calls one routine until the counter reaches its limit, then returns.

name: step_counter_down_by_two
description: Subtracts two from a shared counter while it is not two, and calls one routine after each step.

name: reset_record_fields_and_compute
description: Sets two fields of each of a hundred and fifty-seven records to a fixed negative value, then computes a division-based value from shared state.

name: reset_or_scale_shared_value
description: When a shared value is zero it resets it to a hundred and fifty-eight and calls a routine. Otherwise it calls two routines, clamps the value at its top, halves it with sign and doubles it twice.

name: clamp_and_double_shared_value
description: Calls a routine, clamps a shared value above a limit, halves it with sign, then doubles it twice and returns.

name: increment_counter_and_call_two
description: Increments a shared counter and then calls two other routines.

name: increment_counter_and_call_two
description: Increments a shared counter and then calls two other routines.

name: increment_counter_and_call_two
description: Increments a shared counter and then calls two other routines.

name: increment_counter_and_call_two
description: Increments a shared counter and then calls two other routines.

name: call_three_routines
description: Calls three other routines in turn and returns. It does nothing else.

name: increment_counter_and_call_four
description: Increments a shared counter and then calls four other routines in turn.

name: set_blitter_masks_then_run
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, sets its first-word and last-word masks and modulo values, then calls a routine three times.

name: compute_nibble_offset_address
description: Builds a byte from the inverted low nibble of a shared value, derives an address from it using row stride values, and calls one routine.

name: fill_record_fields_by_range
description: Sets two fields of a range of records to a fixed negative value, then sets the remaining records' fields to a fixed positive value, starting from the caller's index.

name: advance_pointer_by_table_offsets
description: Advances a shared pointer by two offsets read from the pointer's own table, calling one routine as it goes.

name: step_pointers_by_table_offsets
description: Advances a shared pointer by the offsets stored at it, unless it has reached one of two end values.

name: reset_shared_counter_and_constants
description: Stores two fixed values into fixed memory addresses and clears a shared counter.

name: call_eight_routines
description: Calls eight other routines in turn and returns.

name: clear_byte_range
description: Zeroes a run of bytes starting at the address in the address register, for the count given in the data register plus one.

name: initialise_state_and_draw_records
description: Initialises a large set of shared fields and table values, then calls sixteen routines that fill and update the display records.

name: load_record_values_from_table
description: Reads four words from a source record, stores three of them doubled into shared state, and uses the fourth as an index into a table to look up a further value.

name: return_empty_stub
description: Empty routine that returns at once. One other routine calls it.

name: set_shared_address_and_mode
description: Stores a fixed address into shared state, sets a mode value of two, and returns.

name: wrap_angle_pair_modulo
description: Adds two input deltas to a pair of stored 16-bit values and wraps each one into the range of a fixed period of seven hundred and twenty, adding the period back when the sign bit is set.

name: copy_tile_rows_from_table
description: Copies a block of rows from a source table entry, selected by the caller's index, into the destination, skipping the copy when the entry or the shared buffer is null. It calls one other routine.

name: clear_word_buffer
description: Zeroes a buffer of twenty-five thousand two hundred and eighty words, one word at a time, starting at the address in the address register.

name: copy_wide_tile_rows
description: Copies a block of rows from a source table entry into the destination with a wider row width, skipping the copy when the entry or the shared buffer is null. It calls one other routine.

name: copy_tall_tile_rows
description: Copies a taller block of rows from a source table entry into the destination, skipping the copy when the entry or the shared buffer is null. It calls one other routine.

name: draw_text_glyph_rows
description: Looks up each character of a text string in a font table by subtracting the first printable code, then copies nine rows of glyph data into the output. It calls two other routines.

name: draw_text_glyph_rows
description: Looks up each character in a font table by subtracting the first printable code and copies nine rows of glyph data into the output, without the setup step of its neighbour.

name: draw_text_glyph_rows
description: Looks up each character of a text string in a font table by subtracting the first printable code, then copies nineteen rows of glyph data into the output. It calls two other routines.

name: draw_text_glyph_rows
description: Looks up each character in a font table by subtracting the first printable code and copies nineteen rows of glyph data into the output.

name: draw_text_glyph_rows
description: Looks up each character of a text string in a font table by subtracting the first printable code, then copies thirty-nine rows of glyph data into the output. It calls two other routines.

name: draw_text_glyph_rows
description: Looks up each character in a font table by subtracting the first printable code and copies thirty-nine rows of glyph data into the output.

name: copy_wide_tile_rows
description: Copies a block of rows from a source table entry into the destination with a wider row width, skipping the copy when the entry or the shared buffer is null. It calls one other routine.

name: copy_tall_tile_rows
description: Copies a taller block of rows from a source table entry into the destination, skipping the copy when the entry or the shared buffer is null. It calls one other routine.

name: copy_wide_tile_rows
description: Copies a block of rows from a source table entry into the destination with a wider row width, skipping the copy when the entry or the shared buffer is null. It calls one other routine.

name: clear_word_run
description: Zeroes a run of three thousand one hundred and sixty words starting at the address in the address register.

name: open_library_and_start_copper
description: Opens a library through the exec OldOpenLibrary function, stores one of its fields, then sets the copper list address, starts the copper and writes the DMA control mask.

name: enable_vertical_blank_interrupt
description: Stores an interrupt-related address in shared state and writes the interrupt enable mask for the vertical blank interrupt. It calls one other routine.

name: disable_all_interrupt_sources
description: Sets the top bit of a shared interrupt word, then writes a mask that clears every interrupt-enable bit to the interrupt registers, and returns.

name: dispatch_interrupt_request_state
description: Checks a shared value through several branches and calls up to nine routines according to the result, touching the interrupt request register on the way.

name: subtract_graded_byte_columns
description: Subtracts one from the first column of twelve bytes spaced forty bytes apart, then two from the next column, stepping through the buffer. It has no other effect.

name: subtract_graded_byte_columns
description: Subtracts one from the first column of twelve bytes spaced forty bytes apart, then two from the next column, stepping through the buffer. It has no other effect.

name: subtract_graded_byte_columns

name: subtract_graded_byte_columns
description: Subtracts one from the first column of twelve bytes spaced forty bytes apart, then two from the next column, stepping through the buffer. It has no other effect.

name: subtract_graded_byte_columns_counted
description: Subtracts an increasing value from each of a counted number of byte columns, each column twelve bytes spaced forty bytes apart, and stops when the count runs out. It calls one other routine.

name: write_sprite_control_pairs
description: Clears a shared word and writes a pair of control words into each of two table entries spaced eight bytes apart.

name: select_display_mode_by_index
description: Sets shared display-mode values, chooses between two values by the low bit of its input, looks up a table entry from its shifted index, and calls four routines. It reads the beam position register.

name: copy_strided_word_block
description: Copies a block of twelve rows of seventeen words, reading the source at a stride of three words and writing them consecutively into the destination.

name: add_packed_decimal_digits
description: Adds packed decimal digits from two bytes with carry, decimal-adjusting each result, and steps a counter on each digit. It is used to update decimal values in memory.

name: add_packed_decimal_digits

name: add_packed_decimal_digits

name: advance_linked_digit_list
description: Decrements a counter in a list header and, when it runs out, reloads it and follows a link to the next list entry, returning the entry's first word.

name: advance_linked_digit_list
description: Steps a counter in a list header and, on underflow, reloads it and follows the stored link to the next entry, copying words from the list.

name: call_two_routines_pass_through
description: Calls two other routines and returns with its register arguments unchanged.

name: call_routine_pass_through
description: Calls one other routine and returns its register arguments unchanged.

name: call_two_routines_pass_through
description: Calls two other routines and returns with its register arguments unchanged.

name: call_two_routines_pass_through
description: Calls two other routines and returns with its register arguments unchanged.

name: call_routine_pass_through
description: Calls one other routine and returns its register arguments unchanged.

name: call_routine_pass_through
description: Calls one other routine and returns its register arguments unchanged.

name: call_routine_pass_through
description: Calls one other routine and returns its register arguments unchanged.

name: scale_packed_nibbles_by_factor
description: Multiplies each of the four 4-bit fields of a word by a factor from a register, reassembles the words and stores them in a destination array. It calls one other routine.

name: scale_packed_nibbles_clamped
description: Scales the four 4-bit fields of each word by a factor clamped to sixteen, storing the results in a destination array.

name: advance_record_state_machine
description: Advances a per-object state machine held in a record: it selects a branch from a state field, updates counters and positions in the record, and calls four other routines.

name: fill_record_block_when_idle
description: When a record flag is zero, calls a routine and fills a block of records with a fixed negative value, then continues with the rest of the record update. It calls one other routine.

name: read_next_stream_byte_pair
description: Reads the next byte from a stream pointer held in a record. When the byte has its top bit set it first rotates two saved stream pointers, then returns the byte.

name: read_next_stream_word_pair
description: Reads the next word from a stream pointer held in a record. When the word is negative it first rotates two saved stream pointers, then returns the word.

name: parse_stream_command_byte
description: Reads bytes from a stream, stopping on a byte in the range thirty-two to ninety. Other bytes are matched against a table of commands and dispatched through a jump table.

name: copy_record_field_and_return
description: Copies one longword field of a record into another field and returns the constant thirty-two.

name: build_wave_offset_blit
description: Builds a table of three hundred and twenty offsets by stepping two phase counters through a 1024-entry lookup table, then programs the blitter and writes a row of words per line. It re-enables DMA at the end and calls three other routines.

name: build_wave_offset_blit
description: Builds a table of three hundred and twenty offsets by stepping two phase counters through a 1024-entry lookup table, then programs the blitter and writes a row of words per line. It re-enables DMA at the end and calls three other routines.

name: decrement_then_start_blit
description: Decrements a shared counter and returns while it is nonzero; otherwise it waits for the blitter, programs its control and size registers and calls one routine.

name: start_blit_with_countdown
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its control, mask, modulo and pointer registers from fixed values and shared state, decrements a counter and calls one routine.

name: parse_stream_command_byte
description: Reads bytes from a stream, stopping on a byte in the range thirty-two to ninety. Other bytes are matched against a table of commands and dispatched through a jump table. It calls four other routines.

name: copy_stream_bytes_into_buffer
description: Copies bytes from a stream into a buffer, decoding each byte from a shared pointer; bytes at or above a threshold trigger a repeat operation. It calls two other routines.

name: blit_text_glyph
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then programs its registers to copy one glyph from a font table, indexed by the character code minus the first printable code.

name: wait_raster_then_run_steps
description: Calls a fixed routine and four other routines in turn, one of them a wait for a raster line, and returns its register arguments unchanged.

name: clear_sprite_table_entries
description: Writes a fixed control value and zero into two blocks of nineteen entries spaced six bytes apart, clearing a sprite table.

name: advance_angle_table_entries
description: Adds two to each of forty stored values spaced six bytes apart, wrapping each one back by the period of seven hundred and twenty when it exceeds it.

name: decrement_counter_read_beam_position
description: Decrements a shared counter and, when it reaches zero, reads the beam position register and resets its state, then calls one routine.
